metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting ghosts and somehow got that 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic WTF
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was swatting air and boom, 1 kill outta nowhere.
Enemy probably paused to question reality.
Did NOT deserve that chaos but hey, I’ll take it.
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
